hero.label: Security
hero.title: Your Data. Your Infrastructure. Your Control.
hero.desc: Sovereign deployment model means your data stays on your infrastructure. No third-party cloud dependencies, no data aggregation, no shared tenancy.

features.title: Self-Hosted Infrastructure
features.text: CCASH deploys on your own servers — bare metal, colo, or cloud of your choice. Your data never touches infrastructure shared with other operators.

features.title: Data Isolation by Design
features.text: Each operator's data lives in its own isolated environment. A breach or issue in one deployment cannot cascade to another. Smaller attack surface means fewer things that can go wrong.

features.title: No Single Point of Failure
features.text: Critical operations require multiple independent approvers. No single person — not even platform administrators — can unilaterally access sensitive data or make system changes.

features.title: Audited & Verified
features.text: All platform components undergo security audits before release. Deployment scripts are version-controlled and signed. Published audit reports available for review.

info_blocks.title: Why Self-Hosting Matters
paragraphs: Most platforms operate a multi-tenant model where everyone's data lives in one shared database on rented cloud infrastructure. When that infrastructure gets breached — and breaches happen — every tenant is exposed at once.
items: Sovereign deployment: Purpose-built infrastructure on your own servers, not shared cloud resources
Data isolation: Your deployment's data is walled off from every other deployment
Encrypted everything: Data encrypted at rest and in transit with keys you control
Multi-party controls: Sensitive operations require approval from multiple independent keyholders
Minimal footprint: We collect only what's legally required — less data stored means less data at risk

info_blocks.title: Deployment Security
paragraphs: CCASH uses Ansible-based deployment with signed releases and reproducible builds. All communication between services is authenticated and encrypted. Secrets management uses hardware-backed key storage where available.

info_blocks.title: Incident Response
paragraphs: Documented incident response procedures with automated monitoring. Security incidents are communicated transparently to affected parties within regulatory timeframes. Runbooks cover common scenarios from service degradation to full breach response.
